clue.text: Distracted abroad, accompanied by 21 & 14?

clue.text: Wife present at which place?

clue.text: See 6

clue.text: Smell Communist victory — I must leave conflict

clue.text: Storyteller with Irish name

clue.text: Cans for singer Stevie?
